title: Main Reh Gayi Aan Kali Hun Cheti Aa Veeran
body:
Teri Judayi Ch Muk Chalay Meray Sah Veeran
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Vekhiya Khawaban Ch Meray Saaray Veer Nay Maray Gaye
Aaye Sham-e-Ghareeban Lutt Pay Gaye Aatay Saray Khaimay Saray Gaye
Main Veikhya Saar Nangay Karbal Vich Aal-e-Aaba Veeran
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Din Da Turr Gaya Ay Teri Yaad Sataundi Ay Menu
Ghaar Aja Veeran Tu Akbar Teri Behan Bulandi Ay Tenu
Mangni Ay Duawan Main Nanay Day Rozay Ja Veeran
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri Akhri Hasrat Hay Taino Sehra Lawan Main Akbar
Teri Janj Charhdi Nu Vaikhan Main Atay Shagan Manawan Main Akbar
Menu Lagda Aye Maar Jana Main Dil Vich Lay Ay Chah Veeran
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Paak Imam Di Dhi Sughara Maidaan Di Karbal Ki Hona
Teray Seenay Tut Jaani Barchi Atay Khaak Tay Asghar Nay Sona
Chachay Jeya Ho Janay Dariya Tay Bazoo Juda Veeran
<<DIVIDER>>
Kisay Behan Da Door Bhira Howay Bara Okha Vaila Langda Ay
Ay Waasta Nikhri Sughara Da Shahid Ay Duawan Mangda Ay
Shala Jag Tay Na Howay Kisay Behan Da Kohi Juda Veeran
